pages.title: Decide what an AI agent may do — before it does it | Agent Assembly
pages.description: Agent Assembly decides whether an AI agent’s action is allowed before that action runs — on the paths you route through it — and records what was decided, so a risky call can be refused, or blocked pending a decision, instead of discovered afterwards.

pages.title: 在 AI 代理動手之前，決定它可以做什麼 | Agent Assembly
pages.description: Agent Assembly 會在動作執行之前，決定某個 AI 代理的動作是否被允許 — 範圍限於你導流經過它的路徑 — 並記錄所做的決定，讓有風險的呼叫可以被拒絕，或在決策做出前先行阻擋，而不是事後才被發現。
